subject: Offer surface slices & entitlement bands — marketplace kickoff

Subject: Marketplace offer slices & regional eligibility — kickoff

Hi Aditya / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this — CloudMarket Pro is ready to start mapping Redwood's offering into the three storefronts (AWS, Azure, GCP). We want to align on the minimal viable "offer surface" per cloud and the entitlement bands that drive co-sell certification.

Goals for this thread:
- Agree a shortlist of 3 offer slices (Starter, Scale, Enterprise) and what features/limits each exposes per cloud.
- Flag any regions we cannot publish to (gov/sovereign) or where we need a different SKU.
- Surface metering dimensions that differ by marketplace (vCPUs vs. tokens vs. fixed seats).

I've attached a draft mapping (20270629-offer-slice-proposal.xlsx) — it includes a column for "entitlement band" that ties to co-sell requirements. Quick asks: can you confirm Redwood's canary regions per cloud, and any hard exclusions?

Sam + AWS SA are looped to call out technical listing constraints. Proposed 30-min sync after you've reviewed the sheet.

Cheers,
Maya
Marketplace Partnerships | CloudMarket Pro

Attachment: 20270629-offer-slice-proposal.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34KB)

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@cloudmarketplacepro.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, sam.turner@cloudpartner.co
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace offer slices & regional eligibility — kickoff

Thanks Maya — reviewed the sheet quickly. A few immediate notes:

1) Offer surface: Starter should be API-only (hosted) with soft limits; Scale exposes dedicated reservations and higher throughput; Enterprise includes private deployment entitlements (VPC/on-prem) and SLA options. We want to avoid mixing private entitlements into a single SKU on AWS for listing simplicity.

2) Metering: AWS wants AMI/instance-based metering for dedicated offers; GCP/Azure prefer a fixed SKU + usage dimension. We should keep a canonical internal mapping (token-per-second) but publish per-cloud metrics.

3) Regions/Exclusions: GovCloud and Azure US Government need explicit exclusions — we'll attach govcloud-exclusions.pdf. Also need a separate SKU for eu-north variants where data residency requires separate billing.

Canary regions (proposal):
- AWS: us-east-1, us-west-2
- Azure: eastus, westeurope (minimal)
- GCP: us-central1, europe-west1

I'll set up a follow-up with the marketplace SAs. Karthik, can you confirm whether Dedicated/Private entitlements require separate product IDs per cloud from a sales packaging perspective?

- Aditya
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachment: govcloud-exclusions.pdf (pdf, 12KB)

On Tue, Jun 29, 2027 at 11:03 AM aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com> wrote:
> I'll set up a follow-up with the marketplace SAs. Karthik, can you confirm whether Dedicated/Private entitlements require separate product IDs per cloud from a sales packaging perspective?

Short answer: yes, usually. Longer: For co-sell enablement we need a clear mapping between the marketplace product ID and our internal SKU so that pipeline motions and partner credits are trackable. If we bundle Dedicated with a "bring-your-own-license" private option, that complicates quoting.

A few product/marketing constraints to consider (from my side):
- Listing copy should not promise on-prem unless we have a documented installation SLA.
- For Scale tier we should publish a throughput metric (tokens/sec) but call out per-cloud measurement differences in a footnote.
- Bundled trials: avoid offering Dedicated trial via marketplace; use hosted credits instead.

I've uploaded a short checklist (canary-region-checklist.docx) with suggested gating items (billing test, license key flow, telemetry plumbing). Please review before the SA call.

-Marissa
Director, GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachment: canary-region-checklist.docx (docx, 18KB)

From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@cloudpartner.co>

Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace offer slices & regional eligibility — kickoff

Thanks for the context — quick tech notes from the Marketplace SA side:

- AWS: yes, Dedicated/Private offers typically use separate product IDs (Listing + PrivateOffer) and may require different AMIs/packaging. Billing dimension can be an instance-hour SKU or a custom usage dimension hooked to metering endpoints.
- Azure: Marketplace wants a single offer with multiple plans where possible (we can model Starter/Scale/Enterprise as plans). Private/Azure Marketplace Disconnected scenarios are handled via separate offers.
- GCP: prefers offer variants tied to entitlements; there is room to publish a single listing with multiple SKUs but metering is per-usage-dimension.

I've attached a short matrix I put together after the SA call — highlights required packaging changes per cloud and a minimal canary list. Also noted there are additional certification steps for co-sell on AWS (partner validation + salesplay submission).

Next step: schedule a 30-min technical alignment with the SAs and product engineering to confirm artifact list. I'll propose Wed 7/7 or Thu 7/8.

- Sam
Cloud Partner Solutions

Attachment: sa-packaging-matrix.pdf (pdf, 22KB)
